title: File direct skill work with its actual surface
when: Filing an agreed Dash or Task spec from a harness skill.
need: The skill supplies harness_skill; Task/Dash commands default to cli. Both aliases use one intake guard. Planned intake still requires Idea scaffolding; caller authority, workflow surfaces, spec acceptance and execution-instruction attestation remain enforced. An item's workflow is fixed at filing; the planned-intake refusal teaches the change: re-file under the new workflow, cancel the old item with --ref NEW, and re-declare its db claim with yoke db-claim amend.
surface: Dash and Idea filing skills; shared item-create help and refusal; lifecycle intake recipe
review: Candidate policy and isolated dispatch fixtures cover direct skill filing and planned-item refusal; live release proof remains pending.
